parts.t: Government Road is one of Burnaby's oldest and most character-rich neighbourhoods, featuring heritage homes, established gardens, and a strong sense of history. Located in North Burnaby near Simon Fraser University, it appeals to buyers who appreciate architectural charm and community identity.
